title: 万城纪 · 原创游戏美术
origin: Generated with OpenAI image_gen.imagegen for this project under the user's direction. No artwork was extracted from 模拟帝国 or any other game.
rights: Generated for use in this project, subject to the applicable image-generation service terms.
style: Hand-painted realistic 2:1 isometric miniature ancient architecture; upper-left sunlight; transparent PNG/WebP.
reusePolicy: Each civilization has 16 distinct primary sprites. Functional workshops, market stalls, public services and selected landscape/facility sprites are shared. Five unique special buildings and five distinct endgame wonders are provided in the landmarks atlas. Housing's simulation levels map to three architectural tiers; construction/upgrade effects apply at every simulation level.

animation.timing: Foundation/wall/upgrade loop frames at 240ms. Roof frames advance with construction progress to avoid reversing completion.
animation.night: Runtime light masks clipped to sprite alpha and local warm emissive lighting. No separate painted night atlas.

processing: Transparent foreground component extraction, antialias-preserving crops, WebP encoding, common construction frame canvas and sprite sheet packing. Original generated PNG atlases retained.
